title: Te Manawanui Tuturu
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka poropiti, he tokoiti noa iho te hunga i whakamanawanui i tēnei mate nui me te mamae tinana me te whakapono pumau. Ko te kōrero a tēnei tangata he akoranga mutunga kore mō te manawanui me te whakawhirinaki ki te whakaaro nui o te Atua. Ko wai tēnei wairua?
clues: I whiriwhiria ahau e Allah ki te kawe i tētahi karere, engari ko te whakamātautau nui rawa atu i puta mai i te whakakorenga, engari i puta mai i te aituā whaiaro.
I tangohia aku taonga, aku kararehe, me aku tamariki, tetahi i muri i tetahi.
Kī tonu tōku tinana i ngā mate pukupuku, ā, i mahue iho ko au anake me te tautoko a taku hoa rangatira.
I karanga ahau ki tōku Ariki, me te whakaae ki tōku mamae, me te rapu i Tōna aroha.
I whakahaua ahau kia papaki i te whenua ki tōku waewae, ā, ka pupu mai he puna whakahauora.
I whakahokia mai e te Atua tōku hauora, i homai hoki he whānau hou ki ahau, me te taonga nui atu i tōku o mua.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te ngaronga o te taonga me te whānau
Te maka ki roto i te ahi
Te wehenga atu i te whānau, te hokonga atu hei pononga
Te whakamatautauria ki te kuao kau koura
trial.answer: Te ngaronga o te taonga me te whānau

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi

outcome.label: Hua
options: Te whakahokinga mai o te whānau me te taonga
Te whakaoranga mai i te tohorā
Te whiwhi i tētahi tama i te koroheketanga
outcome.answer: Te whakahokinga mai o te whānau me te taonga

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
